_comment: Data companion to patches/scuff-wobble.json. The engine's knuckle/wobble only acts on balls faster than ball.nonSpinMin (km/h). Stock 45 means only hard-struck balls wobble, so a scuffed, under-hit pass would never qualify. Lowering it to 25 lets slow mishit passes wobble too. nonSpinMin is proven READ by the exe. On its own this does almost nothing visible - wobble is stripped from mishits until scuff-wobble.json is applied. Apply: python tools/gameplay_tune.py apply tools/data/tunings/scuff-wobble-data.json --stack

edits._note: 45 -> 25 km/h: slow mis-struck passes can wobble
